prompt:
Photograph of a sleek English race-built galleon of the 1580s, a low,
long hull with a low stern and bow, a small raised bow deck and a
moderately raised stern with a square transom and a small gallery, one
row of gun ports: square courses and topsails on the fore and main
masts, a lateen mizzen, a spritsail, the hull painted in bold red, gold
and black bands, red below and black above, under sail at sea, seen from
low over the water, her bow to the left and a little towards us, a blue
sea with white crests and the open sea running to the horizon all round
her and a sky of soft even blue with a few white clouds, a natural
photograph with no frame, no border and no circle. Historical
reenactment photography, sharp focus, realistic. The whole ship is built
of planked wood: no tower, nothing of stone.
